At HEAD, security.holdout.test.js:27-35 loops `d` over `"`, `'` and `` ` `` with backslash prefix `p` in `''` and `\\`. Line 34 builds `${p}${d.repeat(n)}${c} || ${RUN}//`, which for `'` with n=1, k=2 gives `')) || (this.__pwned=1)//`. That is the exact payload the defect asks to add, and line 28 adds `${d})) || (globalThis.__pwned=1)//` for every delimiter. The backslash and backtick forms the defect names are generated the same way. Line 71 does still accept a 400, but the non-throwing payloads now cover all three delimiters, so a throw can no longer pass a leaking route. variants-proof.sh already has the routes the defect asks for: single-quote-raw-injectable (:173), single-quote-escape-injectable (:182), backtick-raw-injectable (:191) and backtick-escape-injectable (:200). The cited line 36 is `}` at HEAD, so the defect describes the earlier state. I did not run variants-proof.sh (the Bash call was refused), so the scores are unverified.
